android.extraProguardRules:
# Expo resolves each module class by the name in expo-module.config.json, so R8
# has no reference to follow and will happily delete it. Everything else in the
# package is reached from here and may be renamed freely -- TrialGuard in
# particular is meant to be obfuscated.
-keep class com.afinitycode.spool.ytdlp.YtDlpModule { *; }

# Named in the manifest, which R8 does not rewrite.
-keep class com.afinitycode.spool.ytdlp.PlaybackService { *; }
-keep class com.afinitycode.spool.ytdlp.DownloadService { *; }

# The engine reaches its bundled Python payload through JNI and reflection.
-keep class com.yausername.** { *; }
-dontwarn com.yausername.**

# The engine unzips its Python payload with commons-compress, whose
# ExtraFieldUtils registers each extra-field type from a static block by
# reflective newInstance(). R8 sees no constructor call, concludes the types are
# never instantiated and makes them abstract; the static block then throws
# "class ... is not a concrete class", the payload never unpacks, and ART caches
# the failed class for the life of the install -- every download after it fails
# with an error no message in the app can explain. Measured on an S21 FE: fresh
# install, engine dead on first extract, permanently.
-keep class org.apache.commons.compress.** { *; }
-dontwarn org.apache.commons.compress.**
